title: त्रिपञ्चाशत्तमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Arjuna asks Uttara to drive towards Drona's golden altar banner, and greets his teacher, saying he will not strike first. Drona attacks, and teacher and pupil fight a long and wonderful duel with divine weapons, until Drona, his armour and banner cut, retreats on swift horses.
summary.kn: ದ್ರೋಣರ ಸುವರ್ಣ ವೇದಿಕಾಧ್ವಜದತ್ತ ರಥ ನಡೆಸೆಂದು ಅರ್ಜುನನು ಉತ್ತರನಿಗೆ ಹೇಳಿ, ತಾನು ಮೊದಲು ಹೊಡೆಯುವುದಿಲ್ಲವೆಂದು ಗುರುವಿಗೆ ನಮಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ. ದ್ರೋಣರು ಆಕ್ರಮಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ, ಗುರುಶಿಷ್ಯರು ದಿವ್ಯಾಸ್ತ್ರಗಳಿಂದ ದೀರ್ಘ ಅದ್ಭುತ ದ್ವಂದ್ವಯುದ್ಧ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾರೆ; ಕವಚ ಧ್ವಜ ಕತ್ತರಿಸಲ್ಪಟ್ಟ ದ್ರೋಣರು ವೇಗದ ಕುದುರೆಗಳಿಂದ ಹಿಂದಿರುಗುತ್ತಾರೆ.
summary.hi: अर्जुन उत्तर से द्रोण की स्वर्ण वेदी वाली ध्वजा की ओर रथ ले चलने को कहते हैं और गुरु को प्रणाम कर कहते हैं कि वे पहले प्रहार नहीं करेंगे। द्रोण आक्रमण करते हैं, और गुरु-शिष्य दिव्यास्त्रों से लम्बा अद्भुत द्वन्द्व लड़ते हैं, जब तक कवच और ध्वजा कटने पर द्रोण तेज़ घोड़ों से पीछे नहीं हट जाते।
summary.te: ద్రోణుని బంగారు వేదికా ధ్వజం వైపు రథం నడపమని అర్జునుడు ఉత్తరునికి చెప్పి, తాను ముందుగా కొట్టనని గురువుకు నమస్కరిస్తాడు. ద్రోణుడు దాడి చేస్తాడు, గురుశిష్యులు దివ్యాస్త్రాలతో సుదీర్ఘ అద్భుత ద్వంద్వయుద్ధం చేస్తారు; కవచం, ధ్వజం తెగిన ద్రోణుడు వేగవంతమైన గుర్రాలతో వెనుదిరుగుతాడు.
summary.ta: த்ரோணரின் பொன் வேள்விமேடைக் கொடியை நோக்கித் தேரைச் செலுத்துமாறு அர்ஜுனன் உத்தரனிடம் சொல்லி, தான் முதலில் அடிக்க மாட்டேன் என்று ஆசிரியரை வணங்குகிறான். த்ரோணர் தாக்க, குருவும் சீடனும் தெய்வீக அஸ்திரங்களால் நீண்ட அற்புதமான தனிப்போர் புரிகிறார்கள்; கவசமும் கொடியும் அறுபட்ட த்ரோணர் வேகமான குதிரைகளால் பின்வாங்குகிறார்.
summary.ml: ദ്രോണരുടെ സ്വർണ്ണവേദിക്കൊടിയുടെ നേരെ തെളിക്കാൻ അർജുനൻ ഉത്തരനോട് പറയുന്നു; ആദ്യം അമ്പെയ്യില്ലെന്ന് പറഞ്ഞ് ഗുരുവിനെ വണങ്ങുന്നു. ദ്രോണർ ആക്രമിക്കുന്നു; ഗുരുവും ശിഷ്യനും ദിവ്യാസ്ത്രങ്ങളാൽ ദീർഘവും അത്ഭുതകരവുമായ യുദ്ധം ചെയ്യുന്നു. ഒടുവിൽ കവചവും കൊടിയും മുറിഞ്ഞ ദ്രോണർ വേഗമേറിയ കുതിരകളിൽ പിൻവാങ്ങുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 4.53; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Thu Dec  1 2011

verses.text: अर्जुन उवाच

meaning.en: Arjuna said:

verses.text:
यत्रैषा काञ्चनी वेदी प्रदीप्ताग्निशिखोपमा ।
उच्छ्रिता काञ्चने दण्डे पताकाभिरलंकृता ।
तत्र मां वह भद्रं ते द्रोणानीकाय मारिष ॥

meaning.en: Where that golden altar stands, bright as a blazing flame, raised on a golden pole and decorated with flags, take me there, to Drona's division, good sir.

verses.text:
अश्वाः शोणाः प्रकाशन्ते बृहन्तश्चारुवाहिनः ।
स्निग्धविद्रुमसंकाशास्ताम्रास्याः प्रियदर्शनाः ।
युक्ता रथवरे यस्य सर्वशिक्षाविशारदाः ॥

meaning.en: His red horses shine, tall and handsome in their stride, glossy like coral, copper-faced and pleasing to see, yoked to the best chariot and expert in all training.

verses.text:
दीर्घबाहुर्महातेजा बलरूपसमन्वितः ।
सर्वलोकेषु विख्यातो भारद्वाजः प्रतापवान् ॥

meaning.en: He is long-armed, of great splendor, endowed with strength and beauty, mighty, and famed in all worlds: Bharadvaja's son.

verses.text:
बुद्ध्या तुल्यो ह्युशनसा बृहस्पतिसमो नये ।
वेदास्तथैव चत्वारो ब्रह्मचर्यं तथैव च ॥

meaning.en: He is equal to Ushanas in wisdom and to Brihaspati in policy; the four Vedas and chastity are in him.

verses.text:
ससंहाराणि दिव्यानि सर्वाण्यस्त्राणि मारिष ।
धनुर्वेदश्च कार्त्स्न्येन यस्मिन्नित्यं प्रतिष्ठितः ॥

meaning.en: Sir, all the divine weapons with their recall are his, and the whole science of archery is always established in him.

verses.text:
क्षमा दमश्च सत्यं च आनृशंस्यमथार्जवम् ।
एते चान्ये च बहवो गुणा यस्मिन्द्विजोत्तमे ॥

meaning.en: Forgiveness, self-control, truthfulness, kindness and uprightness, and many other qualities are in that best of Brahmins.

verses.text:
तेनाहं योद्धुमिच्छामि महाभागेन संयुगे ।
तस्मात्त्वं प्रापयाचार्यं क्षिप्रमुत्तर वाहय ॥

meaning.en: I wish to fight that greatly fortunate one in battle; so, Uttara, quickly drive me to the teacher.

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
अर्जुनेनैवमुक्तस्तु वैराटिर्हेमभूषितान् ।
चोदयामास तानश्वान्भारद्वाजरथं प्रति ॥

meaning.en: Told so by Arjuna, Virata's son urged his gold-adorned horses toward Bharadvaja's chariot.

verses.text:
तमापतन्तं वेगेन पाण्डवं रथिनां वरम् ।
द्रोणः प्रत्युद्ययौ पार्थं मत्तो मत्तमिव द्विपम् ॥

meaning.en: As the Pandava, best of charioteers, came rushing, Drona went to meet Partha, like one rutting elephant meeting another.

verses.text:
ततः प्राध्मापयच्छङ्खं भेरीशतनिनादितम् ।
प्रचुक्षुभे बलं सर्वमुद्धूत इव सागरः ॥

meaning.en: Then he blew his conch, which was echoed by a hundred drums, and the whole army stirred like a stormy sea.

verses.text:
अथ शोणान्सदश्वांस्तान्हंसवर्णैर्मनोजवैः ।
मिश्रितान्समरे दृष्ट्वा व्यस्मयन्त रणे जनाः ॥

meaning.en: Seeing in battle those red horses mixed with fine horses of swan color and mind-like speed, people were amazed.

verses.text:
तौ रथौ वीर्यसंपन्नौ दृष्ट्वा संग्राममूर्धनि ।
आचार्यशिष्यावजितौ कृतविद्यौ मनस्विनौ ॥

meaning.en: Seeing those two valorous chariots at the head of the battle, teacher and pupil, both undefeated, learned and high-spirited,

verses.text:
समाश्लिष्टौ तदान्योन्यं द्रोणपार्थौ महाबलौ ।
दृष्ट्वा प्राकम्पत मुहुर्भरतानां महद्बलम् ॥

meaning.en: Drona and Partha, mighty, closed with each other, and the great army of the Bharatas trembled again and again to see it.

verses.text:
हर्षयुक्तस्तथा पार्थः प्रहसन्निव वीर्यवान् ।
रथं रथेन द्रोणस्य समासाद्य महारथः ॥

meaning.en: Then Partha, glad and as if laughing, the mighty great charioteer, brought his chariot up to Drona's chariot.

verses.text:
अभिवाद्य महाबाहुः सान्त्वपूर्वमिदं वचः ।
उवाच श्लक्ष्णया वाचा कौन्तेयः परवीरहा ॥

meaning.en: The mighty-armed son of Kunti, killer of enemy heroes, bowed and said these gentle words in soft speech.

verses.text:
उषिताः स्म वने वासं प्रतिकर्म चिकीर्षवः ।
कोपं नार्हसि नः कर्तुं सदा समरदुर्जय ॥

meaning.en: "We have lived in the forest, wishing to repay our wrongs. You should not be angry with us, you who are always hard to defeat in battle.

verses.text:
अहं तु प्रहृते पूर्वं प्रहरिष्यामि तेऽनघ ।
इति मे वर्तते बुद्धिस्तद्भवान्कर्तुमर्हति ॥

meaning.en: I will strike you only after you have struck me first, blameless one; this is my resolve, and you should act accordingly."

verses.text:
ततोऽस्मै प्राहिणोद्द्रोणः शरानधिकविंशतिम् ।
अप्राप्तांश्चैव तान्पार्थश्चिच्छेद कृतहस्तवत् ॥

meaning.en: Then Drona sent more than twenty arrows at him, and Partha cut them before they reached him, with skillful hand.

verses.text:
ततः शरसहस्रेण रथं पार्थस्य वीर्यवान् ।
अवाकिरत्ततो द्रोणः शीघ्रमस्त्रं विदर्शयन् ॥

meaning.en: Then the mighty Drona, showing a quick weapon, covered Partha's chariot with a thousand arrows.

verses.text:
एवं प्रववृते युद्धं भारद्वाजकिरीटिनोः ।
समं विमुञ्चतोः संख्ये विशिखान्दीप्ततेजसः ॥

meaning.en: So the battle between Bharadvaja's son and Kiritin went on, each loosing blazing arrows equally in the fight.

verses.text:
तावुभौ ख्यातकर्माणावुभौ वायुसमौ जवे ।
उभौ दिव्यास्त्रविदुषावुभावुत्तमतेजसौ ।
क्षिपन्तौ शरजालानि मोहयामासतुर्नृपान् ॥

meaning.en: Both famed for their deeds, both swift as wind, both knowing divine weapons and of the highest splendor, they bewildered the kings as they sent forth nets of arrows.

verses.text:
व्यस्मयन्त ततो योधाः सर्वे तत्र समागताः ।
शरान्विसृजतोस्तूर्णं साधु साध्विति पूजयन् ॥

meaning.en: All the warriors gathered there were amazed and praised, "Well done, well done," as the two quickly loosed arrows.

verses.text:
द्रोणं हि समरे कोऽन्यो योद्धुमर्हति फल्गुनात् ।
रौद्रः क्षत्रियधर्मोऽयं गुरुणा यदयुध्यत ।
इत्यब्रुवञ्जनास्तत्र संग्रामशिरसि स्थिताः ॥

meaning.en: "Who but Phalguna could fight Drona in battle? This is the fierce Kshatriya duty, that he fights with his teacher," said the people standing at the head of the battle.

verses.text:
वीरौ तावपि संरब्धौ संनिकृष्टौ महारथौ ।
छादयेतां शरव्रातैरन्योन्यमपराजितौ ॥

meaning.en: Both heroes, enraged, great charioteers, close together and undefeated, covered each other with showers of arrows.

verses.text:
विस्फार्य सुमहच्चापं हेमपृष्ठं दुरासदम् ।
संरब्धोऽथ भरद्वाजः फल्गुनं प्रत्ययुध्यत ॥

meaning.en: Drawing his great, gold-backed, hard-to-withstand bow, Bharadvaja, in fury, fought back against Phalguna.

verses.text:
स सायकमयैर्जालैरर्जुनस्य रथं प्रति ।
भानुमद्भिः शिलाधौतैर्भानोः प्रच्छादयत्प्रभाम् ॥

meaning.en: He covered the sun's brightness with nets of shining, stone-whetted arrows aimed at Arjuna's chariot.

verses.text:
पार्थं च स महाबाहुर्महावेगैर्महारथः ।
विव्याध निशितैर्बाणैर्मेघो वृष्ट्येव पर्वतम् ॥

meaning.en: That mighty-armed great charioteer, with very swift sharp arrows, pierced Partha as a cloud pours rain on a mountain.

verses.text:
तथैव दिव्यं गाण्डीवं धनुरादाय पाण्डवः ।
शत्रुघ्नं वेगवद्धृष्टो भारसाधनमुत्तमम् ।
विससर्ज शरांश्चित्रान्सुवर्णविकृतान्बहून् ॥

meaning.en: In the same way the Pandava took the divine bow Gandiva, best at carrying burdens and killing enemies, and cheerfully sent forth many wondrous arrows adorned with gold.

verses.text:
नाशयञ्शरवर्षाणि भारद्वाजस्य वीर्यवान् ।
तूर्णं चापविनिर्मुक्तैस्तदद्भुतमिवाभवत् ॥

meaning.en: The valiant one destroyed the showers of arrows of Bharadvaja's son with arrows quickly loosed from his bow, and it was like a wonder.

verses.text:
स रथेन चरन्पार्थः प्रेक्षणीयो धनंजयः ।
युगपद्दिक्षु सर्वासु सर्वशस्त्राण्यदर्शयत् ॥

meaning.en: Dhananjaya, lovely to behold as Partha ranged in his chariot, showed all weapons at once in all directions.

verses.text:
एकच्छायमिवाकाशं बाणैश्चक्रे समन्ततः ।
नादृश्यत तदा द्रोणो नीहारेणेव संवृतः ॥

meaning.en: He made the sky seem one shadow with arrows on every side, and Drona could not be seen, as though covered in mist.

verses.text:
तस्याभवत्तदा रूपं संवृतस्य शरोत्तमैः ।
जाज्वल्यमानस्य यथा पर्वतस्येव सर्वतः ॥

meaning.en: Covered with the best arrows, he looked like a mountain blazing on every side.

verses.text:
दृष्ट्वा तु पार्थस्य रणे शरैः स्वरथमावृतम् ।
स विस्फार्य धनुश्चित्रं मेघस्तनितनिस्वनम् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing his chariot covered in the battle with Partha's arrows, he drew his varied bow, which sounded like thunder,

verses.text:
अग्निचक्रोपमं घोरं विकर्षन्परमायुधम् ।
व्यशातयच्छरांस्तांस्तु द्रोणः समितिशोभनः ।
महानभूत्ततः शब्दो वंशानामिव दह्यताम् ॥

meaning.en: pulling that terrible, supreme weapon like a wheel of fire, Drona, who graced assemblies, shattered those arrows; a great noise arose, like bamboos being burned.

verses.text:
जाम्बूनदमयैः पुङ्खैश्चित्रचापवरातिगैः ।
प्राच्छादयदमेयात्मा दिशः सूर्यस्य च प्रभाम् ॥

meaning.en: With golden-feathered arrows that surpassed the finest bows, the immeasurable one covered the directions and the light of the sun.

verses.text:
ततः कनकपुङ्खानां शराणां नतपर्वणाम् ।
वियच्चराणां वियति दृश्यन्ते बहुशः प्रजाः ॥

meaning.en: Then crowds of smooth-jointed, gold-feathered arrows flying through the sky were seen many times in the air.

verses.text:
द्रोणस्य पुङ्खसक्ताश्च प्रभवन्तः शरासनात् ।
एको दीर्घ इवादृश्यदाकाशे संहतः शरः ॥

meaning.en: Drona's arrows, fastened to the feathers and shooting from the bow, looked like a single long arrow joined in the sky.

verses.text:
एवं तौ स्वर्णविकृतान्विमुञ्चन्तौ महाशरान् ।
आकाशं संवृतं वीरावुल्काभिरिव चक्रतुः ॥

meaning.en: So those two heroes, loosing great golden arrows, made the sky look as if full of meteors.

verses.text:
शरास्तयोश्च विबभुः कङ्कबर्हिणवाससः ।
पङ्क्त्यः शरदि खस्थानां हंसानां चरतामिव ॥

meaning.en: Their arrows, clothed with heron and peacock feathers, looked like lines of geese flying in the sky in autumn.

verses.text:
युद्धं समभवत्तत्र सुसंरब्धं महात्मनोः ।
द्रोणपाण्डवयोर्घोरं वृत्रवासवयोरिव ॥

meaning.en: A most furious battle took place between the great-souled Drona and the Pandava, like that of Vritra and Indra.

verses.text:
तौ गजाविव चासाद्य विषाणाग्रैः परस्परम् ।
शरैः पूर्णायतोत्सृष्टैरन्योन्यमभिजघ्नतुः ॥

meaning.en: Like two elephants meeting, they struck each other with the points of tusks, hitting with arrows fully drawn and loosed.

verses.text:
तौ व्यवाहरतां शूरौ संरब्धौ रणशोभिनौ ।
उदीरयन्तौ समरे दिव्यान्यस्त्राणि भागशः ॥

meaning.en: Those two valiant men fought with each other furiously, shining in battle, sending forth divine weapons in turn.

verses.text:
अथ त्वाचार्यमुख्येन शरान्सृष्टाञ्शिलाशितान् ।
न्यवारयच्छितैर्बाणैरर्जुनो जयतां वरः ॥

meaning.en: Then Arjuna, best of conquerors, checked with sharp arrows the stone-whetted arrows shot by the foremost teacher.

verses.text:
दर्शयन्नैन्द्रिरात्मानमुग्रमुग्रपराक्रमः ।
इषुभिस्तूर्णमाकाशं बहुभिश्च समावृणोत् ॥

meaning.en: Showing himself, Indra's son, terrible in his terrible prowess, quickly covered the sky with many arrows.

verses.text:
जिघांसन्तं नरव्याघ्रमर्जुनं तिग्मतेजसम् ।
आचार्यमुख्यः समरे द्रोणः शस्त्रभृतां वरः ।
अर्जुनेन सहाक्रीडच्छरैः संनतपर्वभिः ॥

meaning.en: The foremost teacher, Drona, best of weapon-bearers, though he wished to kill that tiger among men, fierce Arjuna, played with him in battle with smooth-jointed arrows.

verses.text:
दिव्यान्यस्त्राणि मुञ्चन्तं भारद्वाजं महारणे ।
अस्त्रैरस्त्राणि संवार्य फल्गुनः समयोधयत् ॥

meaning.en: Fighting Bharadvaja, who was loosing divine weapons in that great battle, Phalguna countered weapons with weapons.

verses.text:
तयोरासीत्संप्रहारः क्रुद्धयोर्नरसिंहयोः ।
अमर्षिणोस्तदान्योन्यं देवदानवयोरिव ॥

meaning.en: There was a clash between those two lions among men, furious and intolerant of each other, like that of a god and a danava.

verses.text:
ऐन्द्रं वायव्यमाग्नेयमस्त्रमस्त्रेण पाण्डवः ।
द्रोणेन मुक्तं मुक्तं तु ग्रसते स्म पुनः पुनः ॥

meaning.en: Whatever Indra, wind or fire weapon Drona shot, the Pandava swallowed it again and again with a weapon of his own.

verses.text:
एवं शूरौ महेष्वासौ विसृजन्तौ शिताञ्शरान् ।
एकच्छायं चक्रतुस्तावाकाशं शरवृष्टिभिः ॥

meaning.en: So those two brave great archers, loosing sharp arrows, made the sky one shade with showers of arrows.

verses.text:
ततोऽर्जुनेन मुक्तानां पततां च शरीरिषु ।
पर्वतेष्विव वज्राणां शराणां श्रूयते स्वनः ॥

meaning.en: As the arrows shot by Arjuna fell on bodies, a sound was heard like thunderbolts on mountains.

verses.text:
ततो नागा रथाश्चैव सादिनश्च विशां पते ।
शोणिताक्ता व्यदृश्यन्त पुष्पिता इव किंशुकाः ॥

meaning.en: Then elephants, chariots and horsemen, king, were seen soaked in blood like flowering kimshuka trees.

verses.text:
बाहुभिश्च सकेयूरैर्विचित्रैश्च महारथैः ।
सुवर्णचित्रैः कवचैर्ध्वजैश्च विनिपातितैः ॥

meaning.en: With arms bearing armlets, with varied great chariots, with gold-painted armor and banners thrown down,

verses.text:
योधैश्च निहतैस्तत्र पार्थबाणप्रपीडितैः ।
बलमासीत्समुद्भ्रान्तं द्रोणार्जुनसमागमे ॥

meaning.en: and with warriors killed and tormented by Partha's arrows, the army was thrown into confusion when Drona and Arjuna met.

verses.text:
विधुन्वानौ तु तौ वीरौ धनुषी भारसाधने ।
आच्छादयेतामन्योन्यं तितक्षन्तौ रणेषुभिः ॥

meaning.en: Brandishing their bows, which could carry any burden, those two heroes covered each other, wishing to cut each other down in battle with arrows.

verses.text:
अथान्तरिक्षे नादोऽभूद्द्रोणं तत्र प्रशंसताम् ।
दुष्करं कृतवान्द्रोणो यदर्जुनमयोधयत् ॥

meaning.en: Then a voice arose in the sky from those praising Drona: "Drona has done a hard thing, to have fought Arjuna.

verses.text:
प्रमाथिनं महावीर्यं दृढमुष्टिं दुरासदम् ।
जेतारं देवदैत्यानां सर्पाणां च महारथम् ॥

meaning.en: Arjuna is a crusher, mighty, firm-gripped, hard to approach, a victor over gods, daityas and serpents, a great charioteer."

verses.text:
अविश्रमं च शिक्षां च लाघवं दूरपातिताम् ।
पार्थस्य समरे दृष्ट्वा द्रोणस्याभूच्च विस्मयः ॥

meaning.en: Seeing Partha's lack of rest, his training, his lightness and long-range shooting in battle, Drona was amazed.

verses.text:
अथ गाण्डीवमुद्यम्य दिव्यं धनुरमर्षणः ।
विचकर्ष रणे पार्थो बाहुभ्यां भरतर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: Then Partha, angry, raised the divine bow Gandiva and drew it with both arms in the battle, Bharata bull.

verses.text:
तस्य बाणमयं वर्षं शलभानामिवायतम् ।
न च बाणान्तरे वायुरस्य शक्नोति सर्पितुम् ॥

meaning.en: His rain of arrows spread like locusts, and not even the wind could pass between the arrows.

verses.text:
अनिशं संदधानस्य शरानुत्सृजतस्तदा ।
ददृशे नान्तरं किंचित्पार्थस्याददतोऽपि च ॥

meaning.en: As he continuously aimed and loosed arrows, there seemed no gap at all as Partha drew them too.

verses.text:
तथा शीघ्रास्त्रयुद्धे तु वर्तमाने सुदारुणे ।
शीघ्राच्छीघ्रतरं पार्थः शरानन्यानुदीरयत् ॥

meaning.en: As that terrible fight of quick weapons went on, Partha shot other arrows faster and faster.

verses.text:
ततः शतसहस्राणि शराणां नतपर्वणाम् ।
युगपत्प्रापतंस्तत्र द्रोणस्य रथमन्तिकात् ॥

meaning.en: Then hundreds of thousands of smooth-jointed arrows fell at once close to Drona's chariot.

verses.text:
अवकीर्यमाणे द्रोणे तु शरैर्गाण्डीवधन्वना ।
हाहाकारो महानासीत्सैन्यानां भरतर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: When Drona was being showered with arrows by the Gandiva-wielder, a great cry of woe rose from the armies, Bharata bull.

verses.text:
पाण्डवस्य तु शीघ्रास्त्रं मघवान्समपूजयत् ।
गन्धर्वाप्सरसश्चैव ये च तत्र समागताः ॥

meaning.en: Indra himself honored the quick weapons of the Pandava, and so did the gandharvas and apsaras who had gathered there.

verses.text:
ततो वृन्देन महता रथानां रथयूथपः ।
आचार्यपुत्रः सहसा पाण्डवं प्रत्यवारयत् ॥

meaning.en: Then Drona's son, leader of chariot troops, suddenly held back the Pandava with a great mass of chariots.

verses.text:
अश्वत्थामा तु तत्कर्म हृदयेन महात्मनः ।
पूजयामास पार्थस्य कोपं चास्याकरोद्भृशम् ॥

meaning.en: But Ashvatthaman admired that great deed of the great-souled Partha in his heart, though he was very angry at him.

verses.text:
स मन्युवशमापन्नः पार्थमभ्यद्रवद्रणे ।
किरञ्शरसहस्राणि पर्जन्य इव वृष्टिमान् ॥

meaning.en: Gripped by anger, he rushed at Partha in battle, pouring thousands of arrows like a raining cloud.

verses.text:
आवृत्य तु महाबाहुर्यतो द्रौणिस्ततो हयान् ।
अन्तरं प्रददौ पार्थो द्रोणस्य व्यपसर्पितुम् ॥

meaning.en: The mighty-armed Partha, turning his horses toward where Drona's son was, gave Drona a chance to slip away.

verses.text:
स तु लब्ध्वान्तरं तूर्णमपायाज्जवनैर्हयैः ।
छिन्नवर्मध्वजः शूरो निकृत्तः परमेषुभिः ॥

meaning.en: Seizing the chance, Drona, with his armor and banner cut and cut to pieces by the finest arrows, quickly withdrew on swift horses.
